title: Finite Galois torsors admit base change
statement: For schemes X,Y, a finite group G, a finite étale G-torsor Z→X in the sense of [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], and f:Y→X, there are a finite étale G-torsor W→Y and a morphism ρ:W.P→Z.P making the square with W.π, Z.π and f cartesian as in [def-pc-fibre-product].

proof.text: Take W.P to be the actual pullback of Z.π and f, W.π its second projection and ρ its first. For each g∈G the pullback universal property lifts (ρ≫Z.smul g,W.π) to an endomorphism a g. Its projection identities prove compatibility with the base, the unit law, and the multiplication law by pullback hom extensionality. Finite, étale, and surjective properties follow from Mathlib base-change stability.

The square between the finite coproducts of W.P and Z.P is cartesian by FinitaryPreExtensive.isUniversal_finiteCoproducts and the cartesian squares on the summands. The square between W.P×Y W.P and Z.P×X Z.P is cartesian: the inverse lift is obtained by lifting its two projections separately, and uniqueness follows from the two pullback universal properties. Both torsor comparison maps commute with these maps, checked after each coprojection and projection using a g≫ρ=ρ≫Z.smul g. IsPullback.of_bot extracts the square between the two comparison maps. The original comparison is invertible, so IsPullback.isIso_snd_of_isIso makes the new comparison invertible. These data form W with the required square.

proof_origin.note: The limit-reduction route is unchanged; finite torsor descent is separated from proved section descent and proved base change.

lean.statement:
theorem GaloisCover.exists_baseChange
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (Z : GaloisCover G X) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    ∃ (W : GaloisCover G Y) (ρ : W.P ⟶ Z.P), IsPullback ρ W.π Z.π f
